coverage_override.reason: The continuous destruction/banishment protection is one printed effect, followed by the material-transfer Ignition Effect and the HOPT draw trigger.

effects.printed_clause: "Shining Brigade" Spell/Trap Cards you control cannot be destroyed or banished while you control 2 or more "Shining Brigade" monsters.
effects.lua_implementation: The two-monster condition now supplies both battle and effect indestructibility to controlled archetype Spell/Trap Cards and prevents their banishment by either player.

official_references.matched_structure: Official unqualified 'cards cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects' registers both EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_BATTLE and EFFECT_INDESTRUCTABLE_EFFECT over LOCATION_ONFIELD.
Official unqualified cannot-be-banished protection uses player-targeted EFFECT_CANNOT_REMOVE.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: only effect destruction was prevented; unqualified 'cannot be destroyed' also requires battle indestructibility when a protected Spell/Trap Card is functioning as a monster.

effects.printed_clause: Once per turn: You can detach 1 material from a "Shining Brigade" Xyz Monster you control; attach 1 "Shining Brigade" monster from your hand or GY as material.
effects.lua_implementation: The Ignition Effect selects a face-up archetype Xyz Monster with material, detaches one as cost, retains that Xyz Monster, then overlays one legal archetype monster from hand or Necrovalley-permitted GY.

official_references.matched_structure: Official Xyz effects remove overlay material as cost and use Duel.Overlay for attachment.

effects.printed_clause: If a "Shining Brigade" monster you control activates its effect: You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Shining Brigade - Stand Together!" once per turn.
effects.lua_implementation: The HOPT EVENT_CHAINING trigger now requires the controller's archetype monster effect to be activated by a handler controlled in the Monster Zone with an MZONE activation location, then draws one.

official_references.matched_structure: Official 'monster you control activates its effect' condition checks controller, handler in LOCATION_MZONE, and activation location LOCATION_MZONE.
Official effect declares CATEGORY_DRAW and resolves with Duel.Draw.

effects.issue: Confirmed and corrected: the prior condition accepted Shining Brigade monster effects activated from the hand, GY, or banishment because it checked only activating player and archetype.
